However, it explicitly refers to "the experiments", which clearly identifies the part of the paper being addressed, so the authors can confidently pinpoint the referenced part. The comment also clearly specifies the issue: the experiments lack comparisons with relevant distillation methods (DMD, DEQ, DFOSD) and explains why these methods are relevant. This makes the comment both explicitly grounded in a specific part of the paper and specific about what needs to be addressed, satisfying the conditions for the top level of the rubric.
